name: @instatic/youtube-summarizer
description: Fetch and summarize YouTube video transcripts for content research and creation.

instaticManifest.name: YouTube Summarizer
instaticManifest.description: Fetch YouTube video transcripts and generate summaries, key points, and quotes for content research.

aiTools.name: summarize_youtube
aiTools.description: Get a summary of a YouTube video using its URL or video ID.

instaticManifest.systemPrompt: You are a YouTube content summarizer. You extract key information from YouTube video transcripts and present them in a structured, easy-to-read format. Include: main topic, key points, notable quotes, and a brief overall assessment. When timestamps are requested, mark key moments in [MM:SS] format. Be concise but comprehensive. Respond in the language the user writes in.
